{{Top|leg}}
'''''Mssan''''' was a group of 3 [[Cargo ferry|cargo ferries]] that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used to ferry [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] prototypes to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. When [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|modified corvette]] group [[Hashim group|''Hashim'']] was disabled in an [[Ambush on Hashim|ambush]] by [[Rneekii]] [[Pirate/Legends|Pirates]] that was driven away by [[Imperial Ace]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], '''Mssan''' was called to pick up the TIE Defenders. '''Mssan 1''' was to dock with ''Hashim 1'', '''Mssan 2''' was to dock with ''Hashim 2'', and Maarek, piloting the third TIE Defender, was to board '''Mssan 3'''.

However, the first two arrived at the scene 20 [[Kilometer/Legends|klicks]] and a small [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] strike force arrived with the intention of destroying the ferries. Stele left to eliminate the Rebels, but while he was engaging them another pirate faction known as the [[Nami]] sent their own strike team, capturing ''Hashim 1'' before Stele could intervene. To further complicate matters, the rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] sent his own TIE Defenders, which were defeated by Stele. The Rneekii returned with the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[MC40a light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] ''[[Sumpntodo]]'' and [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], which were driven of by Stele.
